title: Soundness of the I2F interpreter, generalised over the argument generator
intent: The headline I2F soundness theorem `I2F_interpreter_param` (the reference interpreter over infinite memory refines the interpreter over finite memory) is proved in one tactic line by generalising the interpreter over its argument generator: `I2F_interpreter_gen` proves the refinement for any pair of `I2F_refine_MCFG (Forall2 I2F_dvalue)`-related argument generators, and `I2F_build_main_args` discharges that one premise for the concrete generator `build_main_args`.
also_known_as: prove a general lemma over a parameter, then specialise
parametrise over the argument generator and instantiate at build_main_args

parent.name: I2F_interpreter_param
parent.statement:
Theorem I2F_interpreter_param :
  forall (args : list string) (prog : ll_toplevel_entities),
    I2F_refine_MCFGbot (prod_rel I2F_FusedS I2F_dvalue)
      (@interpreter_param PInf args prog)
      (@interpreter_param PFin args prog).

children.name: I2F_interpreter_gen
children.statement:
Lemma I2F_interpreter_gen :
  forall (ret_typ : dtyp) (entry : function_id)
    (arg_gen1 : @MCFGtop PInf (list (@dvalue PInf)))
    (arg_gen2 : @MCFGtop PFin (list (@dvalue PFin)))
    (prog : ll_toplevel_entities),
    I2F_refine_MCFG (Forall2 I2F_dvalue) arg_gen1 arg_gen2 ->
    I2F_refine_MCFGbot (prod_rel I2F_FusedS I2F_dvalue)
      (@interpreter_gen PInf ret_typ entry arg_gen1 prog)
      (@interpreter_gen PFin ret_typ entry arg_gen2 prog).
children.closed_by: eapply I2F_interp_mcfg_bind (initial-state branch by `apply I2F_initial_FusedS`; continuation branch by `now apply I2F_denote_vellvm`)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: I2F_interpreter_gen: for any two argument generators related by I2F_refine_MCFG (Forall2 I2F_dvalue), interpreter_gen at PInf refines interpreter_gen at PFin

children.name: I2F_build_main_args
children.statement:
Lemma I2F_build_main_args : forall (args : list string),
    I2F_refine_MCFG (Forall2 I2F_dvalue)
      (@build_main_args PInf args) (@build_main_args PFin args).
children.closed_by: rbind I2F_dvalue; [apply I2F_allocate_args | ]; ... apply ruttc_ret; repeat constructor; auto
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: I2F_build_main_args: build_main_args at PInf refines build_main_args at PFin under Forall2 I2F_dvalue

applicability.goal_shape: A refinement `I2F_refine_MCFGbot R (f PInf …) (f PFin …)` between two instantiations of a parameterised computation (here the memory-model parameter `PInf`/`PFin`), where the concrete top-level function is literally defined as a general function applied to a fixed sub-computation (here `interpreter_param := interpreter_gen … (build_main_args args) prog`).
applicability.use_when: the concrete function is a direct specialisation of the general one, so the general refinement's premise is exactly the statement of a single helper (`I2F_build_main_args`) about the shared sub-computation; the instance then falls out by `apply` of the general lemma and the helper.
applicability.avoid_when: the concrete function is not a plain instantiation of the general one (there are steps between), or the premise the instance needs is itself as hard as the target — then the generalisation buys nothing and the glue stops being one line.

claims.claim: `I2F_interpreter_gen` occurs in the parent site, so the general lemma is the one the glue applies.
`I2F_build_main_args` occurs in the parent site, so the concrete argument generator is the instantiation the glue supplies.
No `admit`, `Admitted`, `Axiom` or `axiom` token occurs in `src/rocq/Theory/I2F/I2F_toplevel.v` lines 231-463, the span that holds the parent and its two children.

The theorem-scale shape is: 2 direct lemmas (`I2F_interpreter_gen`, `I2F_build_main_args`), a longest project-lemma chain of depth 3 below `I2F_interpreter_param`, a 9-line parent site, and child sites of 17 and 9 lines.

metrics.how_counted: glue proof = lines 461-462 of the parent site (the two tactic lines `intros.` and `apply I2F_interpreter_gen, I2F_build_main_args.`); children = the two child sites, each ending in `Qed`

consequences: The move creates exactly one obligation, the premise of `I2F_interpreter_gen`: that the concrete argument generators are related, `I2F_refine_MCFG (Forall2 I2F_dvalue) (build_main_args PInf args) (build_main_args PFin args)`, which `I2F_build_main_args` discharges. The saving comes from `interpreter_param` being a *pure* instantiation of `interpreter_gen` (`TopLevel.v:332`); if the top-level function did anything after `interpreter_gen`, the glue's `apply … , I2F_build_main_args` would no longer match and the one-line assembly would break. The soundness theorem is only as strong as `I2F_interpreter_gen`, which rests on `I2F_interp_mcfg_bind` (bind congruence of `interp_mcfg`, `I2F_interp.v:756`), `I2F_initial_FusedS` (the initial fused states refine) and `I2F_denote_vellvm` (whole-program denotation refinement); a change to the denotation or the interpreter monad has to be re-proven there, not in this glue.
